artists.biography: Daniel Dumile was an English-born American underground hip hop artist best known for his "super villain" stage persona and unique lyrics. Daniel Dumile has taken on several stage names in his career, most notably as MF DOOM. He has appeared in several collaborative projects such as Danger Doom (with Danger Mouse), JJ DOOM (with Jneiro Jarel) and Madvillain (with Madlib).

perplexity.description:
MM..Food is the fifth studio album by British-American rapper and producer MF Doom, released through Rhymesayers Entertainment on November 16, 2004. The album serves as the official sequel to Doom's landmark debut Operation: Doomsday (1999), continuing the narrative arc of the Metal-Faced Villain character through skits sampled from Spider-Man cartoons and other sources. Following a period of experimental work with projects like Madvillainy and Vaudeville Villain, Doom returned to more familiar sonic territory with this release, which peaked at number 17 on Billboard's Independent Albums chart and number 9 on the Heatseekers Albums chart.

Musically, MM..Food pairs late 1970s and early 1980s Quiet Storm R&B samples with hard-hitting hip-hop drums and beatboxes, creating a cohesive production aesthetic that Doom largely handled himself. The album's title is an anagram of the artist's name, and its thematic focus extends throughout the tracklist, with most songs featuring food or drink-related titles and lyrical content. While Doom produced the majority of the album, select tracks featured outside production from collaborators including Madlib ("One Beer"), Count Bass D ("Potholderz"), and Molemen's PNS ("Kon Queso"), though these contributions maintained stylistic consistency with the album's overall vision.

The album has endured as a significant work in Doom's catalog, gaining recognition through posthumous certifications including RIAA Gold status for "Hoe Cakes" and "One Beer," and Platinum certification for "Rapp Snitch Knishes" in 2024. MM..Food remains notable for its meticulous sample work, sharp lyricism, and production craftsmanship, establishing itself as a landmark independent hip-hop release of the 2000s.
